description: Frozen S2 framing wrappers drafted as data. Each direct/step pair differs only by an explicit later-use clause. The caller supplies the task content after choosing graph facts and split membership. Training has 32 pairs; validation and test each have eight independently worded pairs. No language model runs when the builder reads this file. Automated checks enforce neutral framing and separation between splits and from the frozen S1 held-out wrappers; wording remains available for human review.
